name: Darjeeling
tagline: Tea gardens, the toy train and Kangchenjunga at dawn
summary: Darjeeling is a Himalayan hill station on a ridge facing Kangchenjunga, the world's third-highest mountain. Watch sunrise light the peaks from Tiger Hill, ride the UNESCO toy train, tour tea estates and taste first-flush Darjeeling, and wander the Mall and Tibetan monasteries.
seasonNote: October and November give the clearest mountain views; monsoon (June to September) brings cloud and landslides.
arrival: Fly to Bagdogra or take a train to New Jalpaiguri, then 3 hours by shared jeep or car.
gettingAround: Walk the ridge; taxis for Tiger Hill and tea estates.
cashTip: UPI is everywhere but foreign cards may not link; carry rupees for small places and taxis. Tip about 10 percent in restaurants.
foodTip: Momos, thukpa, Tibetan bread and of course Darjeeling tea.
baseArea: Near the Chowrasta and the Mall

connections.note: Fly to Bagdogra, then 3 hours by road.
